description: Read Forge for your workspace: the pricing models the nightly job trained on your own reported quotes (for the workspace and its busiest products, the model and data window it chose and how often the market drifted), each with the rung it reached on the promotion ladder (bench, then replay on your logged quotes) and every gate's evidence; the recent runs; and the pricing experts the self-recoding coder wrote and tested on the test bench, without their source. Nothing here changes a price. Not available until Forge is switched on for your workspace. Needs a Last Price credential with routing read scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

limit.description: Most candidates to return. Defaults to 50.

stage.description: Only candidates at this rung, e.g. replay.
